category.spicedcider.client.tooltip: Settings that only apply to your game client.
category.spicedcider.compat.tooltip: Fixes and integrations for other mods. Only shown if the relevant mod is installed.
category.spicedcider.nether.tooltip: Heat haze, mist and biome-tinted shadows in the Nether.
category.spicedcider.vista.tooltip: Performance tuning for Vista's mirror reflection rendering. Only shown if Vista is installed.
category.spicedcider.voxy.tooltip: Fog distance and density for Voxy's LoD terrain. Only shown if Roxy is installed.
category.spicedcider.weather.tooltip: Cloud cover transitions and sun dogs.
commands.weather.set.mostly_clear: Set the weather to mostly clear
commands.weather.set.partly_cloudy: Set the weather to partly cloudy
effect.spicedcider.lure.description: Fish bite sooner. Gained from perfect catches, and stacks up to III with consecutive perfect catches.
item.spicedcider.heavy_hook.desc: Favours larger fish, which fight more slowly
item.spicedcider.light_hook.desc: Casts farther, fish fight more slowly
item.spicedcider.pocket_jukebox.empty: Put music discs in the Pocket Jukebox to play them
item.spicedcider.sticky_grappling_hook.d: Good for climbing, not fishing. Adheres to walls rather than bouncing off them.
option.spicedcider.bedExplosionPreventio: Beds don't explode outside the Overworld; instead they show a message and wake sleeping villagers.
Registers Every Compat wood-type variants (seats, palisades) for The Block Box. Requires The Block Box, Every Compat, and Moonlight Lib. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.caveMaps.tooltip: Maps in the Nether and other dimensions with a ceiling show the terrain at a usable height instead of the bedrock roof.
option.spicedcider.caveMapsCreationHeigh: Dimension ids where maps always show the height they were created at, even without a ceiling.
option.spicedcider.caveMapsFixedHeight.t: Height maps show in dimensions with a ceiling when Use Map Creation Height is off.
Entries like minecraft:the_nether=40. Maps in these dimensions always show this height, overriding the other settings.
option.spicedcider.caveMapsUseCreationHe: In dimensions with a ceiling, maps show the terrain at the height where they were created. When off, the fixed height is used.
option.spicedcider.cloudCoverCommandFade: How many seconds clouds take to fade when the weather is changed with /weather. 0 switches instantly.
option.spicedcider.cloudCoverFadeSeconds: How many seconds clouds take to fade between cloud cover states when the weather changes naturally.
option.spicedcider.customDeathSound.tool: Plays C418 - Death when you die.
option.spicedcider.customOptionsScreen.t: Replace the vanilla Options screen with Spiced Cider's single settings screen (sidebar pages, curated options).
option.spicedcider.customWindowTitle.too: Customize the OS window title bar text.
option.spicedcider.disableRecipeBookTrac: Disables recipe book unlock tracking/saving/syncing entirely. Saves memory and disk I/O.
option.spicedcider.endCrystalHealing.too: End crystals with no beam target heal nearby damaged entities and render a beam to their heal target.
option.spicedcider.endCrystalPlaceAnywhe: End crystals can be placed on any block, not just obsidian/bedrock.
option.spicedcider.keepBrokenItems.toolt: Enchanted, named, or elytra items become "Broken" instead of being destroyed when they run out of durability.
option.spicedcider.lodGeneration.tooltip: Generates terrain beyond your render distance in the background so it can be drawn in the distance, out to your Distant Terrain Range. The chunks are never saved, so the world folder doesn't grow.
option.spicedcider.lodGenerationMaxRadiu: Server-side cap, in chunks, on how far LoD terrain is generated around each player. Each player's own Voxy LoD render distance is used up to this limit.
option.spicedcider.lodGenerationSendRate: Chunks per second sent to each player on a server. Singleplayer hands chunks to Voxy directly and ignores this.
Worker threads used to generate distant terrain. 0 picks automatically: an eighth of your CPU threads, between 1 and 4. More is faster but costs frame rate while terrain is generating. Requires rejoining the world.
Hides the arrow depth line (Shallow hit, Lodged, Deep lodged) from Lodged's inventory arrow tooltip. Requires Lodged.
option.spicedcider.lodgedHideBleedingRis: Hides the Bleeding risk line from Lodged's inventory arrow tooltip. Requires Lodged.
option.spicedcider.netherAmbientTint.too: How strongly dark areas of the Nether take on the colour of the biome's air. 0% keeps the vanilla shadows.
option.spicedcider.netherHeatHaze.toolti: Distant terrain in the Nether shimmers in the heat, more strongly and closer up near lava. Also scaled by the Distortion Effects accessibility option.
option.spicedcider.netherMist.tooltip: Faint drifting mist in the Nether air, tinted by the biome. Follows the Particles setting.
option.spicedcider.oldProgressScreen.too: Restore classic style loading/progress screen when loading worlds, saving worlds, or changing dimensions.
option.spicedcider.oldWisteriaTrees.tool: Use Environmental's old 1.19 wisteria tree leaf generation instead of the current sparse/patchy one. Requires Environmental (obviously).
option.spicedcider.randomWorldNaming.too: Auto-generates a random world name on the world creation screen, with a reroll button if Modern World Creation is present.
option.spicedcider.removeQuasiConnectivi: Removes quasi-connectivity from pistons, dispensers, and droppers.
option.spicedcider.respawnAnchorExplosio: Respawn anchors don't explode outside dimensions where they work; instead they show a message.
option.spicedcider.skeletonHealthNerf.to: Skeletons and strays get 12 max health. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.slimeTimeDisableItemM: Disables Slime Time's feature where clicking slimeballs together in inventory merges them. Requires Slime Time.
option.spicedcider.sodiumLightingParityF: Restores vanilla parity for Sodium's Smooth Lighting corner blending, which stretches light further out than vanilla and causes flicker near moving dynamic light sources (e.g. LambDynamicLights). Requires Sodium.
option.spicedcider.spiderRangedWebAttack: Spiders switch to shooting cobweb projectiles at range when their target is trapped.
option.spicedcider.sunDogs.tooltip: Show the rare halos of light that sometimes form on either side of the sun.
option.spicedcider.unifiedPetArmor.toolt: Horse armor works like wolf armor: it tanks the hit, loses durability, and is repaired by right-clicking the pet with the armor's material. Applies to horses and, with wolvesWearAnyArmor, to wolves. Requires a restart to take effect.
option.spicedcider.unmineableBlockSparks: Spawns sparks, plays hit sounds, and displays a warning message when attempting to mine a block that requires a stronger tool.
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorIdleUpdate: Reflection update rate used while the viewer's eye is stationary. Set equal to update rate to disable the idle slowdown.
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorMinUpdateF: The floor that the mirror update rate will never drop below. Values above the base update rate are ignored.
Applies performance fixes to Vista's mirror/TV reflection rendering (better culling, better shared-states, re-render throttling). Requires Vista (obviously).
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorReflection: Max distance in blocks that terrain and entities render to inside a mirror reflection. Only lowers Vista's own television.render_distance (which affects TVs and mirrors). Does not affect TV live feeds.
option.spicedcider.vistaMirrorThrottleBu: Max milliseconds per frame that all mirror reflection renders may take before being throttled.
Regular reflection render rate per mirror, in updates per second, when the frame budget is not under pressure. Values at or above 20 mean effectively every frame.
option.spicedcider.voidWater.tooltip: Fluids at the bottom of the world spill into the void as fading trails you can swim in. Takes effect when a world is next loaded.
option.spicedcider.voidWaterExcludedDime: Dimension ids where fluids never spill into the void. The End is excluded by default because its floor is a sea of Dimensional Tears.
option.spicedcider.voidWaterTrailDecay.t: How quickly void fluid trails fade out. Higher values fade faster.
How many blocks fluid trails extend below the bottom of the world.
option.spicedcider.voxyCaveFogDensity.to: How much closer the fog gets when you are underground, away from the sky. 0% disables cave fog.
option.spicedcider.voxyFogEnd.tooltip: Distance where the fog becomes fully opaque, as a percentage of the Voxy LoD render distance (or the normal render distance if Voxy is not rendering).
option.spicedcider.voxyFogOverride.toolt: Replaces the terrain fog with configurable start and end distances that cover Voxy's LoD terrain, plus weather and cave fog. Disable to use Roxy's own fog.
option.spicedcider.voxyFogStart.tooltip: Distance where the fog begins, as a percentage of the Voxy LoD render distance (or the normal render distance if Voxy is not rendering).
How much closer the fog gets in the Nether's hazy air. 0% matches the Overworld.
option.spicedcider.voxyWeatherFogDensity: How much closer the fog gets during rain, snow and thunderstorms. Thunderstorms count for twice as much as rain. 0% disables weather fog.
option.spicedcider.windowTitleFormat.too: Format string for the OS window title. %v will be replaced with the current Minecraft version.
option.spicedcider.wolvesWearAnyArmor.to: Tamed wolves can be equipped with horse/animal armor as body armor.
spicedcider.emi.brewing.lingering: Makes the brew a Lingering Potion
spicedcider.emi.brewing.splash: Makes the brew a Splash Potion
spicedcider.options.aurora.tooltip: Ribbons of coloured light ripple across the night sky in cold biomes.
spicedcider.options.controller.swap_ab.t: Swap the bottom and right face buttons, like a Nintendo layout.
spicedcider.options.controller.swap_shou: Swap the shoulder bumpers with the triggers, so attacking and using items move to the bumpers.
spicedcider.options.controller.swap_xy.t: Swap the left and top face buttons.
spicedcider.options.controller.vibration: Rumble the controller when taking damage, breaking blocks and other events.
spicedcider.options.custom_stars.tooltip: Fills the night sky with twinkling stars of varied sizes and colours.
spicedcider.options.dynamic_lights.toolt: Lets held torches and glowing mobs light up their surroundings. Faster modes update less often.
spicedcider.options.fog_end.tooltip: How far away the fog becomes fully opaque, as a share of the Distant Terrain Range. Lower values hide distant terrain sooner.
spicedcider.options.fog_start.tooltip: How far away the fog begins, as a share of the Distant Terrain Range. Below 0% the haze starts building right in front of you, so even nearby terrain is slightly fogged.
spicedcider.options.heat_haze.tooltip: Distant terrain in the Nether shimmers in the heat, more strongly near lava. Turn off if screen distortion bothers you.
spicedcider.options.inverted_bell_blur.t: Blurs the screen while teleporting with an Inverted Bell.
spicedcider.options.nether_mist.tooltip: Large banks of faint mist drift through the Nether's air in the distance.
spicedcider.options.nether_tint.tooltip: How strongly dark areas of the Nether take on the colour of the biome's air. 0% keeps the vanilla shadows.
spicedcider.options.shooting_stars.toolt: Stars occasionally streak across the night sky.
spicedcider.options.sun_dogs.tooltip: Rare halos of light that sometimes form on either side of the sun.
spicedcider.options.title: Settings
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_1: A Beacon sits on top of a pyramid of mineral blocks
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_2: Blocks of Iron, Gold, Diamond and other metals can be mixed freely
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_3: Each layer is two blocks wider than the one above, and every extra layer unlocks stronger effects
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_4: A full pyramid has four layers, the bottom one 9 by 9 blocks
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_5: The beacon needs a clear view of the sky
spicedcider.ponder.beacon.text_6: Right-click it and pay with an ingot or a Diamond to choose its effects
spicedcider.ponder.cauldron_brewing.head: Brewing Potions in a Cauldron
spicedcider.ponder.cauldron_brewing.text: Cauldrons brew potions while there is heat right below them
Arrows dipped into the brew come out as Tipped Arrows
Ingredients of different kinds taint the brew, and the Cauldron takes nothing more until it is emptied
Campfires, Fire and Magma Blocks all give heat
Add Nether Wart to a Cauldron of Water to make a Clear Potion
Each ingredient turns the Clear Potion into the potion it belongs to
More ingredients of the same kind make it last longer and grow stronger, up to five in total
Ingredients can be thrown in or added with a right-click
Fill Glass Bottles from the Cauldron, three in total
Gunpowder turns the brew into Splash Potions
Creeper Spores turn it into Lingering Potions instead
spicedcider.ponder.comparator_containers: A Comparator can measure how full the block behind it is
Even a single item gives a signal of 1
The fuller it gets, the stronger the signal, up to 15 when completely full
Comparators also read Cauldrons, Composters, Cakes, Jukeboxes, Lecterns and more
spicedcider.ponder.comparator_modes.head: Comparing and subtracting signals
spicedcider.ponder.comparator_modes.text: Comparators pass the signal from their back out of their front
In compare mode, the output stays on while the back is at least as strong as both sides
Right-click to switch to subtract mode: the strongest side is taken away from the back
Here 15 minus 14 leaves a signal of 1, which fades out before it reaches the lamp
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_1: A Conduit needs a frame of Prismarine blocks around it
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_2: Frame blocks go in 5 by 5 rings centered on it; 16 is enough to activate it
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_3: Prismarine, Prismarine Bricks, Dark Prismarine and Sea Lanterns all count
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_4: The conduit and every block touching it have to be water
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_5: Players in water nearby get Conduit Power; every 7 frame blocks add 16 blocks of range
spicedcider.ponder.conduit.text_6: With all 42 frame blocks, it also attacks hostile mobs close by
spicedcider.ponder.cooking_pot_heat.head: Heating the Cooking Pot
spicedcider.ponder.cooking_pot_heat.text: The Cooking Pot only cooks while there is heat right below it
Stoves, Campfires, Fire, Lava and Magma Blocks all give heat
Over a Campfire or open fire, it rests on a tray
A Hopper between the heat and the pot passes the heat up
The Skillet uses heat the same way
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_1: A Block of Copper topped with a Carved Pumpkin makes a Copper Golem
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_2: Like copper blocks, Copper Golems slowly oxidize
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_3: A fully oxidized golem may freeze into a statue
spicedcider.ponder.copper_golem.text_4: Wax it with Honeycomb to stop the aging, or scrape it back with an Axe
Copper Golems carry items out of Copper Chests
Each item goes into a nearby chest that already holds the same item...
...or into an empty chest when nothing matches
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_1: The Crafter holds a crafting grid and crafts on its own
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_2: Hoppers and Droppers can fill it; each item goes to the slot holding the fewest
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_3: Click a slot in its menu to disable it, keeping the recipe's shape intact
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_4: A redstone pulse makes it craft, pushing the result out of its front
spicedcider.ponder.crafter.text_5: A Comparator reads how many of its slots are filled or disabled
spicedcider.ponder.daylight_detector.hea: Sensing the sun with Daylight Detectors
spicedcider.ponder.daylight_detector.tex: Daylight Detectors give off a signal based on how bright the sky is
The signal is strongest around noon and fades away towards night
Right-click it to invert it, so it measures darkness instead
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_1: Pointed Dripstone hanging under a block drips whatever fluid sits on top of that block
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_2: Place a Cauldron below the tip to catch the drips
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_3: Water fills the Cauldron one level at a time
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_4: Lava drips far more slowly, but fills the Cauldron in one go
spicedcider.ponder.dripstone_farm.text_5: The Cauldron can sit up to 10 blocks below the tip
spicedcider.ponder.film_developing.text_: Film has to be developed before its photographs can be printed
A Spout develops black and white film with Water
Colour film is developed with a Clear Potion
Film can also be developed by crafting it together with the same potion
spicedcider.ponder.gingerbread_golem.tex: Stick a Gumdrop on the front of a Gingerbread block
A Carved Pumpkin on top, facing the same way as the Gumdrop, brings a Gingerbread Golem to life
Sneak and right-click to make it sit or stand
Gingerbread Cookies heal it and patch up its bites
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_1: Hoppers catch items dropped on top and pass them into the block they point at
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_2: They also pull items out of containers above them
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_3: Place a hopper against the side of a block to point its spout that way instead
spicedcider.ponder.hopper.text_4: A redstone signal locks the hopper, stopping it from moving anything
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_1: Four Blocks of Iron in a T shape form the body
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_2: The spaces beside the bottom block have to stay empty
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_3: A Carved Pumpkin or Jack o'Lantern placed on top last brings it to life
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_4: A built Iron Golem fights nearby monsters and never attacks players
spicedcider.ponder.iron_golem.text_5: Hand it Iron Ingots to patch up its cracks
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_1: The Lightroom prints Photographs from developed film
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_2: It only works in bright light, so keep a light source right next to it
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_3: Load developed film, then add Paper and Black Dye for black and white prints
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_4: Colour prints also need Cyan, Magenta and Yellow Dye
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_5: Pick a frame and press Print
spicedcider.ponder.lightroom.text_6: Once printing is done, the Photograph is ready to take out
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_1: A ring of Obsidian at least 4 wide and 5 tall makes a Nether Portal frame
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_3: Use a Dimensional Tears Bottle on the inside of the frame to tear it open
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_4: Every Ruined Portal has a bottle waiting in its chest
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_5: More Tears can be bottled from a charged Respawn Anchor
spicedcider.ponder.nether_portal.text_6: Frames can be as large as 23 by 23 blocks
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_1: Note Blocks play a note when they get a redstone pulse or are punched
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_2: Right-click to raise the pitch, stepping through two octaves
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_3: The block underneath picks the instrument
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_4: Wood gives a bass, Stone a drum, Sand a snare, Gold a bell and Packed Ice chimes
spicedcider.ponder.note_block.text_5: A mob head on top plays that mob's sound instead
spicedcider.ponder.observer.text_1: Observers watch the block in front of their face
spicedcider.ponder.observer.text_2: Whenever that block changes, they send a short pulse out of their back
spicedcider.ponder.observer.text_3: Crops growing, doors opening and blocks being placed or broken all count
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_1: A Carved Pumpkin placed on top of a Pinecone builds a Pinecone Golem
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_2: Hand it a Sapling and it carries it off
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_3: It plants the Sapling wherever there's room for a tree to grow
spicedcider.ponder.pinecone_golem.text_4: With empty hands it follows anyone holding a Sapling and picks up Saplings lying nearby
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.header: Delaying and locking signals with Repeaters
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_1: Repeaters carry a signal forward and boost it back to full strength
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_2: Right-click to set a delay between 1 and 4 redstone ticks
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_3: Signals only travel through them one way
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_4: A powered Repeater or Comparator pointing into its side locks it
spicedcider.ponder.repeater.text_5: While locked, it keeps its output no matter what its input does
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_1: Hang Pointed Dripstone under a block of Rock Salt
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_2: With Water on top of the Rock Salt, the dripstone starts to drip
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_3: Over time a Salt Spike grows on the floor below the tip
spicedcider.ponder.salt_spikes.text_4: Only one spike grows under each tip until it is broken
spicedcider.ponder.snow_golem.text_1: Two Snow Blocks topped with a Carved Pumpkin make a Snow Golem
spicedcider.ponder.snow_golem.text_2: Snow Golems pelt monsters with snowballs and leave snow wherever they walk
spicedcider.ponder.snow_golem.text_3: They melt in warm biomes and are hurt by water and rain
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_1: A Carved Pumpkin on top of a Barrel makes a Sputter
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_2: Load it with a stack of Arrows and it shoots at nearby monsters
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_4: Use an empty hand to take the Arrows back
spicedcider.ponder.sputter.text_5: A Dye gives it war paint
spicedcider.ponder.tag.golems.descriptio: Blocks that can be built into living helpers, or something worse
spicedcider.ponder.tag.multiblocks.descr: Blocks that only work as part of a larger structure
spicedcider.ponder.tag.redstone_componen: Blocks that send, shape or react to redstone signals
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_1: Taps draw sap out of tree trunks
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_2: The trunk has to belong to a natural tree, with its leaves still attached
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_3: Place a Cauldron up to 3 blocks below the tap to catch what drips out
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_4: Over time the cauldron slowly fills up
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_5: Maple gives Maple Syrup, Spruce and Pine give Resin, and Kapok gives Latex
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_6: Tapping a full Beehive or Bee Nest collects Honey
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_7: Mortars and Basins can catch the drips as well
spicedcider.ponder.tapping.text_8: Right-click the tap to close or open it
spicedcider.ponder.tuning_fork_golems.te: Right-click a Copper Golem with a Tuning Fork to start conducting it
Right-click a block to send the golem there
Right-click the golem again to let it go
Used in the air, the fork rings out towards the nearest geode
spicedcider.ponder.weeping_obsidian.head: Collecting Dimensional Tears
spicedcider.ponder.weeping_obsidian.text: Crying Obsidian slowly weeps Dimensional Tears
A Cauldron below it catches the Tears, as long as there is only air in between
Collect them with a Glass Bottle or a Bucket
Every kind of Crying Obsidian weeps, including Bricks, Pillars and Polished
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_1: Soul Sand or Soul Soil in a T shape forms the Wither's body
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_2: Three Wither Skeleton Skulls on top summon it
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_3: It explodes as it wakes, then attacks everything alive and breaks blocks in its way
spicedcider.ponder.wither.text_4: Summon it far from anything you want to keep
spicedcider.respawn_blocked: The Respawn Anchor is unresponsive in this dimension
